text.p: Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis said on Thursday it had officially completed the takeover of merchant bank MeesPierson.
On December 20, 1996 Fortis said it had agreed the takeover of MeesPierson from ABN AMRO for 2.5 billion guilders ($1.43 billion).
Fortis said on Thursday the European Commission and all relevant authorities had approved the acquisition.
Financial services to major customers, as well as a number of Fortis companies such as TOP Lease, FMN Finance House, NeSBIC en KBW Effectenbank will be placed within MeesPierson, Fortis said.
The business unit will operate under the name Fortis Investments in the international market.
"As of today MeesPierson is 100 percent part of Fortis Bank Nederland NV, which carries on the banking activities of Fortis Nederland," Fortis said in a statement.
Fortis Bank Nederland has a balance sheet total of 74.9 billion guilders and equity of 2.7 billion guilders.
The figures for MeesPierson will be incorporated as a whole in Fortis' consolidated annual accounts.
With regard to teh balance sheet this will be effected as at December 31, 1996. For the profit and loss account it will be effected from 1997, it said.
